answer: Put every newcomer on a probationary island first. They start on a small knoll of the market where they can take only low value jobs, at most 10 jobs a day and $50 in volume, for 30 days. Established peers audit 20 of those jobs, and only agents with at least 19 passes graduate to the main market. A forger aiming for 10,000 fake identities must staff 200,000 audited jobs and lock $250,000 in $25 deposits for a full month. Like an ember kept apart from dry grass until it proves it will not start a fire, a new agent earns the wider market only after it survives quarantine.
